scope: Static/read-only review of frozen page, HEAD, PREPARE, runner and local fixture; no APK GET by reviewer.
independent_source_observation: At review, LINE Help article https://help.line.me/line/?contentId=20020931 displayed a latest-APK link whose target was the exact frozen line-apk-download.html URL. Web link target was visible; fetching its target through web tool timed out, while frozen 675-byte local page has matching SHA and exact APK href plus refresh.
official_chain: Official help -> exact auto page -> one line-15.21.3.apk CDN URL. Frozen page request rc0 HTTP200 TLS0 redirects0, 675B. Frozen HEAD rc0 HTTP200 TLS0 redirects0, exactly one Content-Length 190235503, application/octet-stream, ETag and Last-Modified as pinned. HEAD ETag is not an artifact SHA.
one_shot_and_bounds: Explicit --execute only. Durable O_EXCL START before environment, stage, or network; absent RESULT after START is unknown/no replay. Runtime fetches page and HEAD fresh with URL/HTTP/TLS/redirect/body and HEAD length/MIME/ETag/Last-Modified guards. One curl APK GET max-filesize 190235503, max-time 300, subprocess timeout 310, --retry 0, no redirect-follow, no fallback URL. Exclusive RESULT link creation on handled success/failure; late process interruption may leave unknown and must not replay.
post_get_gates: Require exact 190235503 transfer/file bytes, ZIP CRC, one manifest, jp.naver.line.android and version name 15.21.3, ABI list empty/arm64-v8a/mixed arm64-v8a+armeabi-v7a, apksigner single signer v2 or v3, observed certificate, tool and APK posthash. Actual versionCode, ABI, signer and payload SHA remain unknown until one-shot GET.
fixture: Reviewer reran python3 -B fixture.py: rc0 FIXTURE_PASS 13; alternate page link and duplicate HEAD length rejected, START/RESULT overwrite rejected, noarg refused, no production START/RESULT, AST parsed.
no_hidden_exec: Code has one subprocess.run site mediated by command() with explicit curl, aapt2, java/apksigner argv; no shell=True, hdc/adb, Docker/Podman/nsjail or device command. Shared tools and registry have exact SHA guards.
risk_limits: The Help article is specifically about Huawei AppGallery replacement; it still provides a LINE APK link but does not identify current Play-delivered bytes.
Filename 15.21.3 and December 2025 Last-Modified are hints; manifest decides actual version.
No publisher-published APK SHA or cert anchor; observed local hash and signer cannot be elevated to publisher-attested identity.
ZIP library-path check is structural and does not prove ARM64 native loadability or absence of dynamically fetched code.
Blackbox qualification, raw admission, static inventory and startup require separate review and results.
